faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.a1: Yes. Every offer is reviewed by our moderation team before publication: source, consistency of the information, deadline and official contact details. An expired offer is removed automatically.
faq.a2: Yes. Creating an account, searching and sharing offers are free.
faq.a3: Credits are bought in packs and are used to unlock the full details of an offer and to export your Career Studio documents.
faq.a4: When an offer you shared is unlocked by another user, you receive a share of its value. Earnings become available after a security period and can be withdrawn above a minimum threshold.
faq.q5: Can AI make up information in my CV?
faq.a5: No. AI rewords and structures what you entered. It never adds a degree, an experience or a skill.
faq.a6: Your password is never stored in plain text and your documents are kept in a private space that only you can access.
faq.q7: Which languages does the platform support?
faq.a7: French and English. Offers stay published in their original language.
